news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: ₹0.03 loss per share (vs ₹0.12 loss in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: ₹0.03 loss per share (improved from ₹0.12 loss in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹14.7m (down 9.1% from 3Q 2025). Net loss: ₹526.0k (loss narrowed 74% from 3Q 2025). news.title: New major risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been highly volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 90% of Indian stocks, typically moving 9.0% a week. This is considered a major risk. Share price volatility increases the risk of potential losses in the short-term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. It may also indicate the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent.
